sections.text:
Primary Air Filter & 
 Secondary Air Filter

This document outlines the 
replacement procedure, which must be performed for primary air filters and 
Secondary air filters when filters differential pressure is greater than 4.2 mm 
water gauge, or emergency door open. Changing filters depending on ∆P according 
to the weather of Hurghada city.

Primary air filters and secondary air 
filters to clean the air from dust, small particlesetc.

Replacement of hight pressure filters 
after replacement of prefilter 3 times separately.

The first draft initiated & tested by 
eng. Essam Naguib, reviewed by eng. Mohamed Moussa Embaby, 
revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Abouda EL Bana, 
accepted by eng. Mahmoud Abdel Hady Ahmed general director.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety Category.

sections.text:
Assembly the 
 Secondary air filters at the first then assembly the primary filters

Insert the 
 bottom panel of the filter about half-way into the
 Retainer, making sure that the folds in the filter line up with Retainer partitions.

With both 
 hands, carefully stretch the top panel up and over the upper ends of the wire 
 dividers in the Retainer.

Push both top 
 and bottom panels of the filter in together until the flanges seat against the 
 gasket around the Frame.

Fold the edges 
 of the filter and the flanges over the gasket of the Holding Frame to assure a 
 good seal.

 الإطار (أو الفلتر الأولي) بحيث يتم تثبيت جميع حواف الفلتر على الإطار 
 حشية على إطار التثبيت وثبتها بمشابك التثبيت.
